document_reference: GLM Manual, Section 1.2 Using separated headers
extracted_claim: GLM provides GLSL-compatible types: vec2/vec3/vec4 (float), dvec2/dvec3/dvec4 (double), ivec2/ivec3/ivec4 (int), uvec2/uvec3/uvec4 (unsigned), bvec2/bvec3/bvec4 (bool), mat2/mat3/mat4 (float matrices), dmat2/dmat3/dmat4 (double matrices). Header-only library, no compilation needed.
implementation_relevance: HSE uses glm::vec3 for positions, colors, and normals. GLM is the standard math library for OpenGL C++ projects.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: HSE Primitive uses glm::vec3 for vertex positions and colors

extracted_claim: GLM provides transformation functions: glm::perspective(fov, aspect, near, far) for projection matrices, glm::translate(mat4, vec3) for translation, glm::rotate(mat4, angle, vec3) for rotation, glm::scale(mat4, vec3) for scaling. These are in <glm/ext/matrix_transform.hpp>.
implementation_relevance: HSE uses these functions for camera projection and model transformations.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: HSE Renderer uses glm::perspective and glm::translate for view/projection matrices

document_reference: GLM Manual, Section 3.9 Quaternion types, 3.11 Quaternion functions
extracted_claim: GLM provides quaternion types: quat (float), dquat (double), and functions for quaternion operations. Default storage order is w,x,y,z (can be changed with GLM_FORCE_QUAT_DATA_XYZW). Quaternions are used for rotation representations avoiding gimbal lock.
implementation_relevance: HSE could use quaternions for rotation instead of Euler angles to avoid gimbal lock.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: HSE does not currently use quaternions

extracted_claim: Key GLM configuration defines: GLM_FORCE_CXX17 (force C++17), GLM_FORCE_ALIGNED_GENTYPES (aligned types for SIMD), GLM_FORCE_LEFT_HANDED (left-handed coordinates), GLM_FORCE_DEPTH_ZERO_TO_ONE (Direct3D clip space), GLM_FORCE_SWIZZLE (enable .xyzw/.rgba/.stpq swizzling).
implementation_relevance: HSE should use GLM_FORCE_CXX17 and potentially GLM_FORCE_SWIZZLE for cleaner vector access patterns.

hse_symbol_grounding.notes: GLM configuration not checked in HSE
